body:
Good catch. CTRL-Z during y/n prompt  in Vim just repeats the y/n prompt. Whereas we blindly handle the CTRL-Z.

This didn't happen on 0.1.7. Bisecting ...

issue.title: misc1.c: abort on ctrl-z via ask_yesno, and probably other functions

repository.name: neovim

issue.body:
You can't answer ask_yesno with ctrl-z.

https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/158f8b7ce3051127918148f7f8e9892a4c9ae34f/src/nvim/ui.c#L418-L420

To reproduce, trigger ask_yesno by changing a file whilst editing it:

```
WARNING: The file has been changed since reading it!!!
Do you really want to write to it (y/n)?Aborted (core dumped)
```

https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/87d67814e58b875a1cb4de4c39c252e028b5eafb/src/nvim/misc1.c#L2276
